text:
maria.fin: Hey team — ArborHealth flagged a true-up on their private deployment invoice that looks wrong. Invoice INV-2026-0890 shows a platform fee amount double what we expected. Can someone pull the metering export and confirm whether this is a duplicate license charge or a support-tier proration gone sideways?

olivia.revops: I can look. Do we have the invoice PDF and the metering file? last_time we saw duplicates it was because a migration overlap.

sam.am: Adding context — ArborHealth upgraded support mid-term (Std -> Premium) on 2026-02-11, and we offered a short complimentary overlap week while they validated the private bundle. That might be in the meter as two active SKUs for the same commit.

maria.fin: Attaching the lines from the invoice:
```
INV-2026-0890 line 3: PRIVATE-LICENSE-ARBR-01 qty 1 price 12000 desc: Annual private license
INV-2026-0890 line 4: PLATFORM-FEE-ARBR-01 qty 1 price 12000 desc: Platform fee (annual)
INV-2026-0890 line 5: SUPPORT-PREM-ARBR qty 1 price 3600 desc: Premium support (annual)
INV-2026-0890 line 6: PLATFORM-FEE-ARBR-01 qty 1 price 12000 desc: Platform fee (duplicate?) 
```

jeff.finance: Hmm. Looks like platform fee repeated. If they had a reserved capacity migration, we sometimes create a new platform-fee SKU for the target contract and forget to zero the prior one during the migration script. I'll check the contract records.

billing-bot: [system] Metering export for ArborHealth uploaded to /billing/exports/2026-03/arbor_20260312.csv by billing-scheduler at 2026-03-12T09:03Z :package:

lina.se: I pulled the export. There are two active commitments for the customer for overlapping date ranges: commit_id A-777 (start 2025-04-01 end 2026-03-31) and commit_id B-888 (start 2026-02-10 end 2027-02-09). The overlap window 2026-02-10 to 2026-03-31 shows both platform_fee records billed pro rata.

olivia.revops: That matches. We should pro-rate the new contract from 2026-02-10 and credit the old platform-fee portion for the overlap. The invoice generator should not have created two full-year platform fees. Looks like bug in the migration script mapping commit -> sku_id.

sam.am: Customer expectation: they were told the overlap week was complimentary, but the invoice shows full charges. I chatted with their procurement — they're holding payment until cleared. We need to issue a credit or corrected invoice quickly.

maria.fin: Can finance produce a corrected invoice (crediting duplicate platform-fee line) and a short note explaining the pro-rate? Also want to confirm whether support-tier proration is correct — did we bill a full Premium or did we pro-rate?

jeff.finance: I'll prepare a credit memo for the duplicate platform fee and a corrected INV-2026-0890A. For support: looks like we billed the full Premium annual because the migration script set the support start to the contract start date instead of the upgrade date. We should pro-rate support from 2026-02-11 -> 2027-02-10 and credit the excess.

lina.se: Agreed. On the customer side we promised 7 days of complimentary overlap — we need to apply an additional manual credit equivalent to 7/365 of the platform fee if they actually used the overlap. Do we have a sticky note on the account? Sam, can you confirm the complementary week?

sam.am: Confirmed — SEs gave them complimentary validation week 2026-02-10 -> 2026-02-16. I'll forward the internal sign-off email from solutions@arbor.

maria.fin: Next steps: 1) Jeff to generate credit memo & corrected invoice; 2) Olivia to root-cause migration script and raise a change to prevent duplicate sku mapping; 3) Lina to compute pro-rate and overlap week credit amounts; 4) Sam to send customer sign-off email. ETA EOD tomorrow? @jeff.finance @olivia.revops @lina.se @sam.am

jeff.finance: On it — I'll draft the credit memo today and target sending corrected invoice by COB tomorrow. Will include line-level reasoning and delta.

olivia.revops: I'll open a small postmortem in eng-ticketing and add the migration script patch. Will include test to assert we never emit two platform_fee SKUs for overlapping commits.

lina.se: I'll post the pro-rate calc here after lunch: PLATFORM-FEE 12000 annual -> daily 32.8767 -> credit for overlap duplicate and 7-day complimentary note.

sam.am: Sending customer email now, will cc billing.

maria.fin: Thanks all. Once Jeff has the credit memo, please @maria.fin and I'll approve. Also flag whether this needs executive notification (customer is mid-market but strategic).

jeff.finance: Credit memo ready and uploaded to /billing/credits/CREDIT-2026-0456.pdf. Drafted corrected invoice INV-2026-0890A. Putting logic note in the memo: duplicate platform fee due to migration script failing to retire legacy sku on contract wrap.

olivia.revops: Patch merged to migration repo; adding unit test and a canary run for next 48h.

lina.se: Pro-rate calc: daily = 12000 / 365 = 32.8767. Duplicate overlap period charged 50 days -> 1643.83 credit. Complimentary 7-day credit -> 230.14. Total credit = 1873.97. Rounding to nearest cent -> $1,873.97.

sam.am: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick turnaround — will remit once corrected invoice is updated. Appreciate the credit." :thumbsup:

maria.fin: Approved. Jeff, apply credit on the invoice and push the corrected invoice to the portal. Close loop with customer and mark account note.

jeff.finance: Done. INV-2026-0890A issued; credit applied. Ticket closed.

billing-bot: [system] Invoice update: INV-2026-0890 -> INV-2026-0890A pushed to customer portal at 2026-03-13T18:22Z

maria.fin: Great work. I'll follow up in next week's finance sync to cover any ripple effects for other migrations. :sparkles:
